metadata.description: Skills built in the top30ongithub kit

plugins.name: top30-ops
plugins.description: Datadog app investigator: read-only logs, traces, monitors, deploys and incidents for one service, written up as an investigation report.

plugins.name: top30-data
plugins.description: Oracle-to-Snowflake translation with silent-difference checks, a Snowflake cost investigator, and a read-only pipeline failure triage agent.

plugins.name: top30-coach
plugins.description: Skill trial coach: one skill at a time for a week, logged minutes saved, keep/extend/drop, and the next suggestion for your role.

plugins.name: top30-agents
plugins.description: Agent graph designer (checked graphs, parallel waves, gates by undo cost) and agent loop harness (repair until a check passes, hunt until nothing new; budgets, memory, escalation).

plugins.name: top30-ui
plugins.description: EasyUI's workflow and motion forensics: motion components, your own shadcn registry, diagnosing how a site's animation is really built, and rebuilding scroll-driven canvas scenes.

plugins.name: top30-wensity
plugins.description: Wensity UI dashboards and sites: data file → dashboard plan on free primitives, one theme per project with a token check, landing-page section recipe, and scout/builder/QA agents that install only after approval.
